sources.name: Material Design 3
sources.notes: Use principles and semantic roles. Do not bundle documentation screenshots or illustrations.

sources.name: Material Web
sources.notes: Official M3 web components and tokens.

sources.name: Material Color Utilities
sources.notes: Dynamic color and semantic role implementation.

sources.name: Material Symbols
sources.notes: Product logos are excluded; use only the symbol library.

sources.name: Noto Emoji
sources.notes: Region flags have separate provenance and must be verified individually.

sources.name: Google Sans / Google Sans Flex
sources.notes: Use only official Google Fonts downloads and preserve the bundled license. Product Sans dumps are excluded.

sources.name: Google Brand Resource Center
sources.notes: Google product logos, icons, screenshots, and visual identity are not bundled in distributable assets.

openSource.sourcePolicy: Only official Apache-2.0 upstream assets are stored. Google product marks, screenshots, hosted product UI art, and brand treatments remain reference-only.

selectedMaterialWeb.purpose: Official token SCSS references for motion, shape, state, and elevation decisions.
